title: Agent-Environment Alignment via Automated Interface Generation
abstract: arXiv:2505.21055v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents have shown impressive reasoning capabilities in interactive decision-making tasks. These agents interact with environment through intermediate interfaces, such as predefined action spaces and interaction rules, which mediate the perception and action. However, mismatches often happen between the internal expectations of the agent regarding the influence of its issued actions and the actual state transitions in the environment, a phenomenon referred to as \textbf{agent-environment misalignment}. While prior work has invested substantially in improving agent strategies and environment design, the critical role of the interface still remains underexplored. In this work, we empirically demonstrate that agent-environment misalignment poses a significant bottleneck to agent performance. To mitigate this issue, we propose \textbf{ALIGN}, an \underline{A}uto-A\underline{l}igned \underline{I}nterface \underli

translated_title: 通过自动接口生成实现智能体与环境的对齐
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）智能体在交互式决策任务中展现出了令人瞩目的推理能力。这些智能体通过中间接口与环境进行交互，例如预定义的动作空间和交互规则，这些接口在感知与行动之间起中介作用。然而，智能体对其所发出动作影响的内部期望与环境中的实际状态转移之间经常出现不匹配，这种现象被称为**智能体-环境失配**。尽管先前的研究在改进智能体策略和环境设计方面投入了大量精力，但接口的关键作用仍未得到充分探索。在这项工作中，我们通过实证研究表明，智能体-环境失配是制约智能体性能的重要瓶颈。为了缓解这一问题，我们提出了 **ALIGN**，一种自动对齐的接口生成方法……
tldr: 本文通过实证揭示智能体与环境之间的“失配”问题是LLM智能体性能的重要瓶颈，并提出ALIGN方法，通过自动生成与优化中间接口来实现智能体与环境的对齐，从而提升智能体在交互式决策任务中的表现。
en_tdlr: This paper empirically identifies agent-environment misalignment as a key bottleneck for LLM agents and proposes ALIGN, which automatically generates interfaces to align agents with environments and improve performance in interactive decision-making tasks.
